mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, street_name, is_read, read_time, create_time FROM street_notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND street_name = #{streetName} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE street_notice SET is_read = 1, read_time = COALESCE(read_time, NOW()) WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND street_name = #{streetName} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM street_notice WHERE street_name = #{streetName} AND status = 1 AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE street_notice SET status = #{status} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM street_notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND street_name = #{streetName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO street_notice (notice_id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, street_name, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{publisher}, #{publisherType}, #{publisherDept}, #{topFlag}, #{status}, #{streetName}, 0, #{createTime})
